notes.accuracy_caveat: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon for the current interim installation (Parklab Gardens; the wider parcel also hosts Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and an SFF soccer field per SF Rec & Park's own Future Parks Project page). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because this is explicitly an interim use, not the plan's final build-out: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks Project will redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent, unified extension of the Commons (planning 2024-25, design mid-2026, construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030). This feature traces OSM way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', about 14,665 sq m and roughly 420 m long), the whole Parklab park strip: it fully contains the separately mapped Parklab Gardens way (437595662, about 2,212 sq m) and the Spark Social SF way (437591532, about 1,519 sq m), so it is not only the Parklab Gardens sub-area.

milestones.text: Parklab Gardens (one interim installation inside the mapped Parklab park strip; OCII's Nov 2024 map puts it on P15) opens, per SF Chronicle coverage pairing its opening with Stagecoach Greens mini-golf. Interim-use pilots on the Commons parcels began on P13 in 2016, P15 in 2017 and P12 in 2018 (SF Rec & Park Workshop 3 deck, p.15).

changes.text: The shape notes said the polygon traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area; it is OSM way 446183018, the whole 'Parklab' park strip (about 14,665 sq m), which contains both the Parklab Gardens and Spark Social SF ways, and its OSM tag is leisure=park, not garden. The notes also said P15's concept matches Spark Social SF's use of that parcel; OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update puts Spark Social SF and the community garden on P13 and Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens on P15, and the Workshop 3 deck dates interim-use pilots to P13 (2016), P15 (2017) and P12 (2018). The claim that a design team was selected through an August 2025 RFQ now says what SF Rec & Park reports: an RFQ was released and a team was expected by mid-October. The 'early 2030' opening milestone is relabelled as a whole-project estimate (basis project) with a note that Workshop 3 shows an earlier construction window. The shape log carries a dated correction; notes and digitized_from were corrected in place.
